lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as well as adoption and new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests.
Finish and new_flow changes hurt performance across 2 tests, resulting in negative noise-corrected effects and one test stopped early.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results across all tests.

candidates.title: Choose Path Mascot Stage Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into an interactive stage layout showcasing path options.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a 23.8% drop-off rate with a high mean time of 514s, indicating users need a clearer, more engaging display.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the choose path screen layout.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns have shown no clear positive effect in historical tests.

candidates.title: Story Screen Choice Hint Component
candidates.change: Add a clear hint to the initial story screen explaining the upcoming adoption options.
candidates.why: Users take a median of 8s but a mean of 514s on path choice, suggesting early ambiguity about what selection entails.

story.hint: Next, pick whether to adopt a pre-made pet or create a custom pet.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an informational hint on the story screen.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint component to address high mean time on path selection.

candidates.title: Sign-In Clear Account Data Security Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body copy on sign-in screen to emphasize cloud backup and pet safety.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, making cloud sync messaging crucial during sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet
sign_in.body: Creating an account ensures your pet progress, items, and desktop settings are backed up safely.

guard.reason: Valid update to sign-in copy highlighting security and backup.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support tickets regarding account security during sign-in.

candidates.title: Compact Sign-In Options Layout
candidates.change: Switch the sign-in screen layout to a compact view highlighting quick sign-in actions.
candidates.why: The sign_in step drops off 27.1% of users with an average duration of 567s.

sign_in.hint: Single-click sign in keeps your desktop pet active across app updates.

guard.reason: Valid compact layout update for the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses drop-off at sign-in step with layout optimization.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a carousel layout for selecting pets.
candidates.why: Adoption shows the highest funnel drop-off at 39.1%, requiring a more visual selection pattern.

guard.reason: Valid carousel redesign of the pick friend screen.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but adoption redesigns failed in prior tests.

candidates.title: Adoption Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated confirmation screen right after picking a friend to confirm the pet selection.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high drop-off (39.1%) and a long mean time (1017s), benefiting from a dedicated confirmation step.

new_adoption_confirm.headline: Confirm Your New Companion
new_adoption_confirm.body: Great choice! Let's get your new friend ready for your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a confirmation step within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding new flow screens previously hurt performance and conversion.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Estimated Ready Time Display
candidates.change: Display an estimated time remaining and notification status on the waiting screen while initialization runs.
candidates.why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty during desktop asset generation.

guard.reason: Valid addition of estimated ready time display on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: High wait times at home step benefit from estimated time feedback.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Rotating Tips
candidates.change: Add auto-rotating tip intervals to the waiting screen while desktop pet setup finishes.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple questions post-onboarding regarding desktop controls, which can be taught during the wait.

waiting.hint: Tips automatically rotate while setup completes.

guard.reason: Valid addition of rotating tips to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel wait duration and support tickets point to post-onboarding tip needs.

candidates.title: Home Intro Split View Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a split view layout showing pet welcome graphics and primary control tips.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2%, and support mails show confusion on how to control or interact with pets after setup.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Companion to Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Your pet is now live on your desktop! Click your pet anytime to bring up controls, feed them, or adjust visibility.

guard.reason: Valid split-view redesign of the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from support, but historical finish and redesign changes hurt metrics.

candidates.title: Home Intro Welcome Snack Incentive Badge
candidates.change: Display an interactive welcome snack badge on the home intro screen to celebrate completing setup.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% and mean completion time is very high (5815s), needing an immediate completion reward.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions an unlocked treat/free extra, which violates rule 3.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder, adoption and new_flow, and finish and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests.
Finish and new_flow changes hurt performance across 2 tests, resulting in negative noise-corrected effects and one test stopped early.
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests, though round 7 predicted lower than measured.
